extracted.intended_audience: writers (screenwriters, novelists, short-story writers, journalists, memoirists, narrative non-fiction writers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writers on building effective, multifaceted narratives (across film, novels, short stories, and narrative nonfiction) by following Truby's 22-step approach to character, plot, and moral vision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hero's moral and emotional growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Focuses on the hero's moral and emotional growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Truby's method emphasizes the hero's moral and emotional growth as the core of a compelling story; writers should dig deep within and explore their own values and worldviews in order to create an effective story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the audience care about characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Use specific, useful techniques to make the audience care about their characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book promises concrete techniques that increase audience investment in characters; making readers/viewers care is paired with ensuring characters undergo meaningful development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure characters grow in meaningful ways
rubrics_metrics.description: Create character arcs that demonstrate meaningful growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characters should grow in ways that matter to the story's moral and emotional stakes, supporting the hero's transformation and the narrative's overall impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construct a surprising plot unique to the concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct a surprising plot that is unique to the writer's particular concept.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rather than using generic plot templates, the method teaches how to develop a plot genuinely surprising and specific to the concept, yielding originality and coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Express a moral vision that moves the audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Express a moral vision that can genuinely move an audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should convey a clear moral or thematic vision; Truby stresses expressing that vision in ways that emotionally resonate with readers/viewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build an effective, multifaceted narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an effective, multifaceted narrative using Truby's approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The approach is presented as both insightful and practical, providing a precise set of tools to construct narratives with interlocking elements (character, plot, theme) that function together.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground storytelling in broad sources (philosophy & mythology)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draw on a broad range of philosophy and mythology to inform story techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Truby's lessons incorporate philosophy and mythology as sources for fresh techniques and thematic depth, suggesting writers use such sources to enrich moral and structural elements of their stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorial self-examination to inform story values
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers should dig into their own values and worldviews to create effective stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book advises authors to explore their personal values/worldview as raw material for authentic moral vision and character motivation, implying inward work is part of crafting persuasive narratives.
